jobgether-jobgether:lever:6d8cb00a-7220-.title: Influencer Marketing Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6d8cb00a-7220-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Influencer Marketing Account Manager based in India. This role offers the opportunity to manage international influencer marketing campaigns from planning through execution and performance analysis. You will serve as a key point of contact for creators while ensuring campaigns remain organized, on-brand, and aligned with client objectives. The position combines account management, creator relations, content quality control, campaign operations, and data analysis. You will work across multiple campaigns and markets, identifying opportunities to improve performance and build stronger creator partnerships. Your attention to detail will be essential when reviewing content, tracking deliverables, and maintaining accurate campaign information. The role is well suited to an organized, analytical professional who enjoys working with influencers, data, and fast-moving digital marketing campaigns. You will also have the opportunity to discover high-performing creators and contribute to the growth of international influencer programs. Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with international influencers and content creators. Coordinate influencer marketing campaigns from initial planning through execution, publication, and performance reporting. Review and approve creator content before publication, ensuring compliance with campaign guidelines, brand requirements, and quality standards. Monitor key campaign metrics including engagement, clicks, conversions, promotional codes, and overall performance. Maintain accurate and up-to-date campaign information across Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and similar tools. Identify high-performing influencers and analyze campaign results to uncover opportunities for optimization and future collaborations. Research, approach, evaluate, and recruit new creators who align with client objectives, audiences, and campaign requirements. Track campaign deliverables, deadlines, creator commitments, and other operational requirements. Prepare performance reports and provide ongoing updates on campaign progress and results. Identify content errors, inconsistencies, or process gaps and take appropriate action to maintain campaign quality. Manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail. Requirements 2–4 years of professional experience in influencer marketing, account management, digital marketing, or a related field. Strong understanding of influencer marketing campaigns, creator partnerships, engagement, conversions, and performance metrics. Professional or advanced English proficiency, both written and conversational. Experience using project management, CRM, or campaign management platforms such as Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, or comparable tools. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential issues in content, campaign tracking, and operational processes. Strong analytical and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills when working with influencers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Availability to work according to a Cyprus-based schedule, Sunday through Thursday, starting at 9:30 a.m. EEST. Willingness to sign confidentiality agreements when required. Ability to align professional social media profiles with client projects when necessary. Reliable internet connection and an appropriate home working environment. Benefits 100% remote working arrangement. Opportunity to work on international influencer marketing campaigns. Exposure to bra

jobgether-jobgether:lever:78a4f8f5-c71f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will take ownership of complex operational challenges and translate business needs into scalable product solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help improve processes, systems, automation, and data-driven decision-making. jobgether-jobgether:lever:dcf369ac-cefb-.title: Manager, People Analytics
jobgether-jobgether:lever:dcf369ac-cefb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, People Analytics based in Canada. As Manager, People Analytics, you’ll lead enterprise-wide workforce reporting and analytics across a complex, multi-site organization in Canada and the U.S. You’ll turn people data into clear insights that help leaders make informed decisions across recruitment, retention, reward, performance, learning, and talent. The role combines advanced analytics, data visualization, statistical modelling, and strategic business partnership. You’ll own critical reporting suites and dashboards while improving automation, data quality, governance, and self-service capabilities. Your insights will help identify workforce risks, measure people investments, and connect employee trends to broader operational outcomes. You’ll work closely with People, Recruitment, Operations Analytics, Finance, and executive stakeholders, serving as a trusted analytics expert. This is an opportunity to build and scale a modern people analytics capability with visible impact on organizational performance. Own the enterprise people reporting suite, delivering accurate weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc workforce reporting for operational and executive audiences. Develop and maintain recruitment and workforce dashboards covering metrics such as open roles, time-to-fill, time-to-start, vacancy rates, recruitment activity, recruiter productivity, and hiring pipeline health. Lead enterprise turnover, retention, and workforce stability reporting, including trend analysis, monthly business reviews, leadership reporting, and analysis of voluntary and involuntary departures. Use workforce, exit interview, engagement, performance, and employee movement data to identify root causes, emerging risks, retention opportunities, and employee experience trends. Apply statistical techniques such as trend analysis, regression, hypothesis testing, correlation analysis, forecasting, and predictive modelling to generate actionable insights. Develop analytics and models supporting compensation, incentives, pay equity, internal equity, market competitiveness, promotion, and reward effectiveness. Evaluate learning, leadership development, succession, career progression, and talent programs through meaningful metrics and return-on-investment analysis. Connect people metrics to business and operational outcomes, developing forward-looking insights and recommendations for leaders. Design intuitive dashboards, visualizations, and executive reporting that make complex workforce trends, risks, and opportunities easy to understand. Establish consistent people metric definitions, reporting standards, data governance practices, and data-quality controls across systems and dashboards. Partner with People Technology, Recruitment, Operations Analytics, Finance, and business leaders to improve reporting automation, analytics capabilities, and self-service access to workforce data. Serve as the People function’s subject matter expert for people analytics, influencing strategic decisions through evidence-based insights and recommendations. Help develop a scalable people analytics capability that supports continued organizational growth and strengthens data-driven decision-making across the organization. Requirements: 5–8+ years of experience in people analytics, workforce analytics, business analytics, or a related analytical discipline. Demonstrated experience creating intuitive dashboards, reporting suites, and executive-level analytics that are visually clear, accessible, and actionable. Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into compelling recommendations for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders. oriongroup-oriongroup:greenhouse:4683661.title: Accounting Manager
oriongroup-oriongroup:greenhouse:4683661.description: We are initiating a search for an Accounting Manager to join a commercial refrigeration and HVAC business in Scarborough, Ontario. This role ensures accurate financial statements, strong internal controls, job costing discipline, and timely reporting to support operational and strategic decision-making. The Accounting Manager will manage the accounting team and work closely with operations, service managers, and ownership. Financial Management & Reporting Ensure all bank transactions are recorded and reconciled on a daily basis Ensure all completed jobs are invoiced upon completion; ensure HST returns are calculated, filed, and paid by the end of the following month Monitor Accounts Receivable regularly and own timely AR collection Ensure all supplier invoices are properly recorded to an expense or work order and that suppliers are paid on time; ensure parts are charged directly to a work order or to inventory, and that parts taken from inventory are charged to the correct work order Ensure weekly payroll is properly recorded in the accounts and that labor cost is charged to work orders at the correct absorption rate; ensure union payments are calculated and paid by the 15th of the following month Prepare a monthly list of prepaid expenses and accrued liabilities that ties to the GL Prepare a monthly list of all jobs/work orders not completed by month end, with all costs properly recorded Ensure all revenue is properly classified as Service, Project, or Maintenance, with associated costs reflected in the same categories in Cost of Sales Ensure the technician utilization report is prepared every Monday for the prior week Own and execute a 5-business-day monthly close, ensuring accuracy and consistency Oversee profitability reporting by service line (service, maintenance, construction) Ensure accurate labor costing, technician productivity reporting, and overhead allocation Establish and enforce internal financial policies and controls Own sales tax compliance and reporting, including preparing and filing returns on time Liaise with auditors on audits and compliance matters Lead and mentor the finance team, ensuring efficiency and professional development Own the monthly WIP (work-in-progress) scheduling process across all active projects, ensuring costs incurred, billings to date, and estimated costs to complete are accurately tracked and reconciled to the general ledger Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; Master's degree a plus 6+ years of experience in financial management, accounting, or auditing Proficiency in MS Office, ERP systems, and financial software (e.g., Sage, COINS) Experience in a service-based HVAC or construction industry preferred Excellent leadership, analytical, and communication skills Experience with a unionized workforce a benefit Knowledge of QuickBooks important High attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work under pressure #LI-LL1

The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:8e0e03f0-c11.title: Translation Validator |  Spanish (Spain)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:8e0e03f0-c11.description: About the Role Welo Data is seeking experienced linguists to support a synthetic data generation program for a leading technology client. In this role, you will perform A/B preference testing of machine-generated translations from English into Spanish, helping to evaluate and improve the quality of AI-generated content. As a Translation Validator, you will independently review an English source document alongside two machine-generated translations (Variant A and Variant B), select the preferred translation, and provide a written justification for your choice. Each sample is reviewed by three independent validators working in a blind process. Project Details Job Title: Translation Validation - Spanish (Spain) Location: Remote (Spain) Commitment: 2 weeks Employment Type: Freelance Contract Pay Rate: $14.30/hour
qualifications: Native-level fluency in Spanish (Spain) (written and spoken) .
